label: B25-UCP-INVARIANT-WAIVER-V2
title: Replace unstable raw fitter duplicate counts with a fail-closed normalized UCP invariant contract
reads: T-010 v1 policy/checker and T-012 exporter; these remain byte-for-byte unchanged
docs/tasks/evidence/T-20260909-011.json and its designated raw UCP/reset reports
scope: Add a separate v2 policy/exporter/checker that preserves v1 history while accepting fitter-only terminal ~DUPLICATE selection changes. Run the same v2 policy on complete T-011 raw reports (63/627) and one complete T-013 fresh report set (61/626); both must pass without synthesizing rows or mixing snapshots.

Add negative fixtures for functional endpoint deletion/replacement, hierarchy substitution, cross-corner/check drift, bad clocks, count/detail mismatch, negative detailed slack, provenance/hash drift and every illegal duplicate form.
Run py_compile, fixture matrix, actual T-011 export/check and actual T-013 export/check, then git diff --check.
acceptance: One reviewed v2 invariant policy accepts both historically frozen and fresh fitter duplicate selections while still rejecting any functional endpoint, hierarchy, constraint, timing or provenance drift; v1 files and semantics remain unchanged.
